registry_resolution: Authenticated registry and identity-preserving amendment entries resolved locally. The historical resolver hash is retained for provenance; its live collection-status display has since changed and is not executed here.

metric_definitions.distinct8: Mean distinct verified canonical modes in eight draws, including zero-success prompts.
metric_definitions.pass8: Fraction of prompts with at least one verified answer among all eight observed draws.

aggregation: Equal weights on five domains within each level: 160 prompts and 1,280 responses per model/condition/level.

settings.off_native_evidence: Every accepted response authenticated against its saved native control receipt.

protocol.interpretation: Compare the final-output distribution at each deployment control; disabled explicit deliberation does not imply absence of internal computation.
protocol.on_baseline: Existing audited medium cohort for these exact rows and sample slots; no new medium calls. Generation slots are not paired RNG seeds.
protocol.opus5_python: Original system/user prompt in both conditions; revised Python wording is a separate experiment.
protocol.preflight: First registered sample is the retained canary and counts toward 3840. No outcome-based prompt replacement.
protocol.sampling_controls: Retain original omitted/default temperature and top_p; only provider reasoning switch changes.
protocol.selection_rule: row_index 0 through 31 inclusive in each original frozen domain-level cell
protocol.support_limit: Public native documentation does not certify internal Azure aliases; first retained canary and every received response must pass control validation before admission.
